dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' structures exhibit sharp, high-intensity light-colored perimeters with irregular, jagged geometry against the dark base. The transition from the dark exterior to the lighter interior is immediate, forming a distinct thin-walled boundary.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid light-toned pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily localized in the interstitial gaps between larger macro-annuli and toward the lower lateral periphery.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest macro-annuli in the upper-mid section form an irregular, elongated quadrilateral with the primary axis oriented roughly 30 degrees to the dorsal midline.
